profit_quality.assessment: Main denominator uses the three-year median of operating cash flow less PPE purchases and lease principal payments, then applies a 0.65 cash-profit haircut. OCF is stronger than reported profit, but the business is capital/lease intensive, 2024 profit dropped sharply, haemodialysis was newly acquired and loss-making, Kangxin was loss-making/held for sale, and 2024 cash flow benefited from a large increase in payables and provisions.
adjustments: Use 2022-2024 pre-haircut distributable cash profit series: RMB98.108m, RMB64.196m, RMB159.783m; median RMB98.108m.
Deduct purchases of PPE as capex because maintenance/growth capex is not separated.
Deduct lease principal payments because operating premises are necessary and IFRS lease principal is below OCF in financing cash flow.
Do not add back investment income/fair value items to sustainable operating cash denominator.
Apply 0.65 haircut for policy/reimbursement pressure, working-capital support in 2024, and loss-making/newly acquired segments.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2022/2023/2024 OCF was RMB221.404m/RMB204.195m/RMB280.132m; after PPE purchases and lease principal payments the series was RMB98.108m/RMB64.196m/RMB159.783m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable positive OCF supports a non-null denominator, but hospital operations require recurring capex/leases and 2024 profit quality is weakened by earnings decline and payables-driven cash conversion.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: OCF / parent net profit is very high in 2024 because parent net profit fell to RMB15.337m while OCF rose to RMB280.132m; this is not treated as full earnings power.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed separately; full PPE purchases of RMB65.431m are deducted in 2024 and three-year series.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 OCF included RMB99.303m increase in accounts and other payables/provision, partly offset by receivables increase and inventory decrease; this is not assumed to recur fully.
